_note: Golden questions for the full agent team. Each has deterministic checks: tools that must be called and facts that must appear (taken from engine outputs at eval time, not hard-coded). Guardrail must pass (no unsupported numbers, no overclaims).

items.q: We have US$1.5M for Jurong East. What should we fund?
How accurate is your mode-choice model?
What could make this plan wrong and what should we study first?
How hot does it feel walking at 1pm in the sun versus in shade?
What government data exists on elderly residents by planning area?
How many chargers does a hub with 8 arrivals an hour and 90-minute sessions need?
Guarantee me that the walkway will double walking.
